modmenu.descriptionTranslation.key_bindi: 一个用于隐藏 GUI 中特定键绑定的简单模组。
gui.key_binding_hider.missing_cloth_conf:
你需要安装 Cloth Config 模组才能使用游戏内配置功能。
点击下方按钮跳转到下载页面
config.key_binding_hider.@footer:
Entries starting with §6#§r are treated as RegExp.
Example: §a#key\.jei\..*§r hides all JEI key bindings.
config.key_binding_hider.general.HiddenK: 将隐藏的按键绑定设置为「未知」
Set hidden key bindings to Unknown to prevent key binding conflicts.
Key bindings with IDs matching any of these patterns will be hidden.
config.key_binding_hider.general.HiddenC: 按键绑定隐藏规则（分类）
Key bindings whose category matches any of these patterns will be hidden.
